import pathlib
programs=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda c: min((r, col) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for col, v in enumerate(row) if v == c)[1])
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
        r1, c1 = max(r for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells}
        objects.append((color, r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1, shape))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    prev = None
    for i, (color, oh, ow, shape) in enumerate(objects):
        if i == 0:
            r0, c0 = 0, 0
        elif i == 1:
            ph, pw = objects[0][1], objects[0][2]
            if (ph, pw) == (2, 2) and (oh, ow) == (2, 2):
                r0, c0 = ph, pw-1
            else:
                r0, c0 = ph-1, pw-1
        else:
            pr, pc, ph, pw = prev
            r0, c0 = pr+ph-1, pc+pw-1
        for dr, dc in shape:
            rr, cc = r0+dr, c0+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
        prev = (r0, c0, oh, ow)
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-e55d10dd.py'
